This composition is a maraging steel of the Fe-19Ni-15Co-3Mo-1.5Ti type, similar to grade C300 or C350 with extra Co. I did not look up the dataset row, so this is an estimate from typical values for that grade, not the recorded figure. Yield strengths for these steels run from about 1400 to 2400 MPa. For this Ti and Co level I would expect about 2000 MPa.
